properties.notes: The site is allocated for care accommodation and/or housing development in the Sites and Housing Plan adopted in February 2013. The site is also allocated in the emerging Local Plan 2036, which is currently undergoing an examination in public (consultation on proposed modifications following hearings). This site is partially greenfield and partially brownfield (as shown on the site location plan). The land area in hectares (and resulting capacity estimate) given relates to the brownfield part of the site only.
